files.README.md:
# The telescope dome log

Every log line starts with a timestamp. Logs use the clock stated in the file header.

turns.prompt: Someone in Beijing needs to know when the first SHUTTER_FAULT shows up in the telescope dome log, in their own time. The file is observatory/dome.log. Give it as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
